Anthropic listed on Nasdaq at $111.50, reporting an $80.7 billion loss and $16.3 billion revenue, while emphasizing safety governance.

• The opening price was above the $83 per share price set in the IPO prospectus, valuing the company at roughly $1.5 trillion.
• CEO Dario Amodei used the debut to reiterate the firm’s commitment to safe AI development.
